pages.text: Tier 4 Mekanism unlocks the top of the tech line: the MekaSuit, MekaTool, QIO Network, Fusion Reactor and Antimatter production.

$(bold)MekaSuit:$() The best armor in the pack for tech-path players, modular and upgradeable. Making it takes extensive Mekanism infrastructure.$(br2)$(bold)MekaTool:$() One tool that replaces pick, axe, shovel, hoe and sword, with configurable modes. It is the default endgame tool.

$(bold)Fusion Reactor:$() Makes enormous amounts of RF, enough to run a late-game Mekanism factory comfortably. Building one is a T4 capstone project.$(br2)$(bold)Antimatter:$() Made in the Particle Accelerator. You need it for the highest Mythic Forge catalysts and the MekaSuit Mk2 upgrade, and you can exchange it for Codex progression tokens.

$(bold)No book needed.$() Mekanism Generators and Tools are documented with the core mod at $(bold)mekanismmod.com$().$(br2)$(bold)Next: start the Fission Reactor$(), the on-ramp to Fusion. $(l:icraft:engineering/t4_fusion_antimatter)T4: Fusion & Antimatter$(/l) walks the whole climb.
